Name: Fertilizer Visibility
Author: Pokkki
Description:
[size=3]Small mod that gives you the ability to change the visibility of fertilisers applied to your crop fields. There's four levels ranging from vanishing to bright visbility. Examples of intensity can be found in images.


[/size]
[size=5][b]To install: [/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unpack the zip file you downloaded.[/size]
[*][size=3]Put the folder from the unpacked zip file into your mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]The mod is now installed. A config file generates upon loading up the game and can either be accessed directly in the mod folder, or via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿. The mod[size=3][size=3] can be toggled on and off at any point, changes should apply immediately.[/size][/size][/size]
[/list][list]
[/list][size=3]If you run into problems with installing this mod, best go to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord [/url]﻿and ask for help there.


[/size][size=2]I used American spelling in line with the game, but in this description, you're likely to find British spelling.[/size]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Fertilizer Visibility
Manifest.Description: Toggle the transparency of your fertilizers and make them appear more subtle (or louder).
Manifest.Author: Pokky
